parsed.name: ProScan III显微镜控制器
parsed.description: 这是一台用于显微镜电动附件控制的控制器，可连接并管理滤光轮等模块。根据证据，它可控制最多三个滤光轮并进行位置查询与切换，常用于荧光显微成像中的滤光片选择与多附件协同控制。
parsed.description_en: This is a microscope accessory controller used to operate motorized modules such as filter wheels. Based on the evidence, it can control up to three filter wheels and supports position query and switching, making it useful for fluorescence microscopy and coordinated control of microscope peripherals.
